_comment: Closed log vocabulary shared by every driver. reason, phase, log_tag and evidence_field are closed enums: tools/codegen/codegen-contracts-json.cjs projects them into _shared/core/ports/contracts.json and test-logger-scalars-single-source.cjs fails on any value a driver writes that is not listed here. Adding a value is a deliberate edit of this file, never a regeneration. evidence_record_formatters are the functions whose output an evidence line carries; their name= fields count as evidence fields. Seeded from docs/audits/2026-10-24-log-vocabulary-census.json.

capslock_restore_down.description: The Caps Lock key press that restores the lock state after an output.

clipboard_paste_chord.description: The paste chord that delivers an output through the clipboard.

command_exited_nonzero.description: A checked shell command exited with a non-zero status; the status travels beside the reason.

connector_automation_refused.description: macOS refused the Automation permission to an application.

connector_exit_failed.description: A connector process exited with a failure; its status and stderr travel beside the reason.

connector_input_not_written.description: The input of a shortcut could not be written to its file.

connector_no_input_file.description: The temporary input file of a shortcut could not be created.

connector_osascript_not_started.description: The osascript connector process did not start.

connector_shortcuts_not_started.description: The Shortcuts command line did not start.

ollama_external_runtime_manual.description: The Ollama runtime is external and needs manual service management.

ollama_server_exited_before_publication.description: The Ollama server task exited before it published readiness.

physical_modifier_restore.description: The press that restores a physical modifier after an output.

physical_modifier_restore_retry.description: The retried press that restores a physical modifier.

physical_modifier_up.description: The release of a held physical modifier before an output.

process_deadline_exceeded.description: The process did not finish within its deadline.

process_deadline_refused.description: The native deadline timer of a process was refused.

process_dispatch_failed.description: The native process could not be dispatched.

process_exited_unsuccessfully.description: The process exited with a non-zero status.

process_group_outlived_leader.description: The process group still ran after its leader exited.

process_handle_allocation_failed.description: The native handle for a process could not be allocated.

process_output_exceeds_bound.description: The process wrote more output than its bound allows.

process_output_watch_refused.description: The native watch on a process output pipe was refused.

process_source_admission_refused.description: The request source no longer admitted the process before it ran.

process_stdin_feed_failed.description: The native feed of the process standard input failed.

programmable_publication_stale.description: A programmable hotstring publication was replaced before its output finished.

replacement_key_down.description: A key press of the replacement text of an output.

screen_capture_did_not_finish.description: The capture did not finish; the runner's error travels beside the reason.

screen_capture_no_image.description: The screenshot tool wrote no image.

screen_capture_no_tool.description: No screenshot tool (grim, gnome-screenshot, spectacle, maim) is installed.

screen_capture_tool_failed.description: The screenshot tool failed; its exit code travels beside the reason.

sqlite_exit_receipt_invalid.description: The sqlite command printed an exit receipt that is not a status.

sqlite_exit_receipt_missing.description: The sqlite command printed no exit receipt.

startup_model_disk_insufficient.description: The selected model is missing and the disk cannot hold it.

startup_model_download_declined.description: The selected model is missing and its download was declined.

startup_ollama_unreachable.description: Nothing answers at the Ollama address.

startup_runtime_not_installed.description: The runtime of the selected AI backend is not installed.

touchpad_no_event_node.description: The input device has no event node.

touchpad_no_multitouch_slot.description: The device has no ABS_MT_SLOT, so it cannot report per-finger positions.

touchpad_not_pointing_device.description: The device is not a pointing device.

updater_install_root_unsafe.description: The standalone install root is unsafe.

updater_layout_not_standalone.description: The driver is not in the standalone linux/ sibling layout.

updater_package_owned.description: A system package or immutable bundle owns the install path.

updater_source_path_relative.description: The updater module source path is not absolute.

updater_standalone_files_absent.description: The standalone wrapper or shared tree is absent.

wrap_mutation_cancelled.description: A wrap preference mutation was cancelled before it committed.
